blurb: Guests take guided boat tours to see wildlife, lighthouses, and coastal scenery around Bar Harbor, Frenchman Bay, and Acadia National Park. Tours include sightseeing, nature cruises, puffin and seabird viewing, fishing trips, and private charters. Some tours offer opportunities to see puffins, seals, eagles, and other local wildlife.
